name: A lullaby from Smyrna
about: "Sleep, my daughter, and I will give you Alexandria in sugar, Cairo in rice, and Constantinople to rule for three years": a Greek lullaby Bourgault-Ducoudray noted in Smyrna from Mme Laffon in 1875, in what he calls the eastern chromatic scale (the augmented second between E flat and F sharp). Its opening, without the piano; the melisma in the fourth bar simplified. Notes as pitch:beats, quarter notes as beats.
